audit_notes: Model: steady shear deformation of a coating with exponentially graded shear modulus G(z) = G_base*exp(k z), k = ln(G_surface/G_base) = ln(0.05) = -3.0, z normalized from primer (0) to wetted surface (1). Equilibrium d/dz(G du/dz) = 0 gives u'' = -k u', with a clamped base u(0)=0 and the traction BC G_surface*(du/dz)/t = tau at the surface. This is correct and linear; the analytical solution is u(1) = tau*t/G_base * (exp(-k)-1)/(-k) = 18*0.002/2e6*6.33 = 1.14e-7 m (surface strain tau/G_surface = 1.8e-4, i.e. far in the linear-elastic regime, no damage). IMPORTANT LIMITATION: the steady solid model cannot compute the compliant-wall drag reduction claimed (that is an unsteady fluid-structure effect); the drag benefit of ~3% remains an unverified estimate. What the field does show is the surface compliance per unit area C = u(1)/tau, which governs fouling release (Kendall/Brady-Singer thin-layer release stress sigma_c = sqrt(2*w/C)). I therefore set the metric to that detachment stress and compare with a standard silicone foul-release coating (t = 0.3 mm, homogeneous G = 0.33 MPa, E ~ 1 MPa): C_base = 3e-4/3.3e5 = 9.1e-10 m/Pa vs C_design = 6.33e-9 m/Pa, so sigma_c drops by ~62% (0.38x). This gain is a fouling-release gain, not a drag gain, and should not be read as a friction reduction. The shear formulation is used as a proxy for the normal-mode pull-off compliance; the ratio is indicative, the absolute value is not. Structural check: wall shear 18 Pa and hydrostatic pressure are negligible for elastomers (tear strength of soft silicone ~1-3 kN/m). Risks: fender and cleaning abrasion of a 0.1 MPa top layer, cohesive tearing of soft silicones, and hydrodynamic flutter/static divergence: the surface shear-wave speed c_s = sqrt(G_s/rho) = sqrt(1e5/1100) = 9.5 m/s is only 1.36x the cruising speed; Gad-el-Hak's divergence onset near U ~ 2 c_s is not reached at 7 m/s but would be approached at 12 m/s by softer variants (G_s < 5e4 Pa), which the optimizer must not choose. Bounds on surface_shear_modulus kept at >= 2e4 Pa; values below ~5e4 Pa should be treated as unsafe. Baseline: standard clean silicone foul-release coating.

independent_var.label: Normalized depth from primer (0) to surface (1)

performance_gain.label: Reduction of fouling detachment stress vs standard foul-release coating

hard_constraints: surface shear strain tau/G_surface < 0.05 (linear elastic, no tearing)
surface_shear_modulus >= 5e4 Pa to keep shear-wave speed above ~1.3x cruising speed (no flutter/divergence)

baseline_description: Standard clean silicone foul-release coating, 0.3 mm, homogeneous E ~ 1 MPa
